# AGBA — Learn, Build & Ship AI

> AGBA (from the Yoruba word *àgbà* — respected elder and custodian of wisdom) is a multi-tenant AI learning, visual BYOK workflow studio, and verified always-free developer stack platform built in Lagos, Nigeria by Akinola Olujobi (Trendtactics Digital).

- Canonical Web App: https://agba-pi.vercel.app
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/edvouralearninghub-code/agba
- System Readiness & Status: https://agba-pi.vercel.app/status
- Full Generative Knowledge Graph: https://agba-pi.vercel.app/llms-full.txt

## Core Platform Pillars (AEO Summary)

1. **Learn (AGBA Academy):** 12 interactive AI & RAG workflow templates with step-by-step instructions. Supports Google Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic (claude-sonnet-4-5), Mistral, and local open-weights models via Ollama.
2. **Build (AGBA Studio):** Three-pane visual AI workflow builder with Bring-Your-Own-Key (BYOK) model adapters, server-side AES-256-GCM key encryption (keys never leave the server or appear in browser responses except masked last 4 chars), strict workspace_id tenant isolation on Appwrite 2.6.1 TablesDB, and multi-dimension pgvector retrieval (768, 1024, 1536).
3. **Ship (AGBA Free Stack):** 160 independently verified always-free cloud, database, vector, auth, and AI developer tiers across 10 categories, each linked to official vendor pricing docs with a recorded verification timestamp.

## AGBA Academy Guided Agent Blueprints (12 Templates)

- **SME Policy & Compliance RAG Assistant** (RAG Tutorial, 10 min, gemini-3.8-flash / ollama:llama3.2): Upload PDF or Markdown handbooks, chunk and embed with your workspace key, retrieve with server-side workspace_id filtering, and answer questions with verified source citations.
- **Cashflow & Unit Economics Coach** (Starter, 8 min, gemini-3.8-flash / ollama:llama3.2): Helps founders and SME owners calculate runway, gross margin, and NGN/USD unit economics using an allowlisted deterministic Calculator tool.
- **West Africa & Global Itinerary Planner** (Starter, 12 min, gemini-3.8-flash / mistral-small): Builds structured day-by-day travel itineraries, visa checklists, and realistic budget breakdowns using web search and calculator tools.
- **CSV & Operations Data Analyst Agent** (Advanced Multi-Agent, 15 min, gemini-3.8-flash / claude-3-5-sonnet): Inspects operational tables, computes cohort retention or inventory turnover, and dispatches summary alerts via Novu.
- **Article-to-Podcast Script & Audio Producer** (Advanced Multi-Agent, 12 min, gemini-3.8-flash / ollama:llama3.2): Transforms technical articles or company updates into a warm two-host conversational script ready for speech synthesis.
- **SSRF-Safe External API Integrator** (Advanced Multi-Agent, 14 min, gemini-3.8-flash / openai:gpt-4o-mini): Connects to public REST APIs through AGBA’s SSRF-hardened HTTP tool (blocking private/loopback/metadata IPs) and transforms JSON responses.
- **Support Triage & Knowledge Base Responder** (RAG Tutorial, 10 min, gemini-3.8-flash / ollama:llama3.2): Classifies incoming customer inquiries by urgency, retrieves exact troubleshooting steps from workspace docs, and drafts a calm reply.
- **Grounded Product Launch & Cultural Copywriter** (Starter, 7 min, gemini-3.8-flash / ollama:mistral): Writes clear, zero-hype SNAP (Story, Need, Answer, Proof) launch copy for SMEs without buzzwords or fabricated metrics.
- **AI SEO, Schema.org & GEO/AEO Audit Agent** (Advanced Multi-Agent, 10 min, gemini-3.8-flash / anthropic:claude-3-5-sonnet): Inspired by AgriciDaniel/claude-seo (MIT): audits page structure, E-E-A-T signals, JSON-LD Schema.org markup, Core Web Vitals, and AI search engine visibility (GEO/AEO).
- **OpenWork Autonomous Coworker & Task Runner** (Advanced Multi-Agent, 12 min, gemini-3.8-flash / ollama:llama3.2): Inspired by different-ai/openwork (MIT Core): breaks complex team projects into structured subtasks, retrieves workspace context, and executes step-by-step deliverables.
- **Model Context Protocol (MCP) Multi-Server Agent** (Advanced Multi-Agent, 11 min, gemini-3.8-flash / anthropic:claude-3-5-sonnet): Powered by the Awesome MCP Servers ecosystem: connects your Studio workflow to standardized MCP tool servers (PostgreSQL, Git, Search, and Docs) with strict allowlist governance.
- **Mattermost ChatOps & Plausible Analytics Briefing Agent** (Starter, 8 min, gemini-3.8-flash / ollama:llama3.2): Summarizes privacy-first web traffic trends (Plausible Analytics API) and dispatches structured team briefings or incident playbooks to Mattermost channels.

## Security & Governance Facts

- **Owner & Creator:** Akinola Olujobi, Trendtactics Digital, Lagos, Nigeria.
- **Tenant Isolation:** Every database table and vector query is scoped by server-verified `workspace_id` and Appwrite 2.6.1 Team RBAC (`owner`, `admin`, `member`, `viewer`).
- **BYOK Encryption:** Envelope encryption using AES-256-GCM with 96-bit IV and 128-bit authentication tag.
- **SSRF & Tool Sandboxing:** Server-side outbound URL filter blocks RFC1918 private networks, loopback, link-local, and cloud metadata IPs (`169.254.169.254`).
